title: paperboy
text: paperboy R package collects article HTML news websites parses tidy data frame four required fields: datetime, author, headline, text. supported news site parser, contributed community. package intentionally thin coordination layer: almost interesting code lives individual parser files.

title: paperboy
text: Project type: R package Language: R (≥ 4.1.0) ~180 parsers R/deliver_*.R, one per supported domain Entry points users: pb_collect() → pb_deliver() Entry point contributors: use_new_parser() /new-parser <URL> (Claude Code) Daily health monitoring: paperboy-pulse dashboard

title: paperboy
text: pb_deliver() dispatches individual parsers via S3 class derived article URL: class name produced paperboy:::classify(adaR::ada_get_domain(url)), lowercases domain replaces . - _. Every parser therefore single S3 method predictable name. specific parser exists, pb_deliver_paper.default (generic parser) used fallback.

title: paperboy
text: minimal parser looks like :
code: #' @export pb_deliver_paper.www_example_com <- function(x, verbose = NULL, pb, ...) {    pb_tick(x, verbose, pb)                        # progress bar — always keep this   html <- rvest::read_html(x$content_raw)        # x$content_raw is the raw HTML string    datetime <- html %>%     rvest::html_element("[property='article:published_time']") %>%     rvest::html_attr("content") %>%     lubridate::as_datetime()    headline <- html %>%     rvest::html_element("[property='og:title']") %>%     rvest::html_attr("content")    author <- html %>%     rvest::html_element(".byline-author") %>%     rvest::html_text2() %>%     toString()                                   # always collapse to one string    text <- html %>%     rvest::html_elements(".article-body > p") %>%     rvest::html_text2() %>%     paste(collapse = "\n")    s_n_list(datetime, author, headline, text)     # always the last line }

title: paperboy
text: datetime must pass lubridate::as_datetime(). author must end toString() produce single string. text must join paragraphs paste(collapse = "\n"). s_n_list() always return value. ensures every element length-1 converts NULL NA. Extra fields beyond four required ones automatically moved misc column. add comments beyond four field-label comments; template already includes .

code: test_data <- pb_collect("https://denverpost.com/feed") library(httr2) test_data <- request("https://search.mediacloud.org/api/") %>%   req_url_path_append("search/story-list") %>%   req_headers(     Authorization = paste("Token", Sys.getenv("MC_TOKEN")),     Accept = "application/json"   ) %>%   req_url_query(     q = "*",     start = format(Sys.Date() - 7, "%Y-%m-%d"),     ss = 107736L # source ID — look it up via the Media Cloud search UI   ) %>%   req_perform() %>%   resp_body_json() %>%   purrr::pluck("stories") %>%   dplyr::bind_rows()
